PreviewCode TSX import { Slider } from "@/registry/base/ui/slider"; export default function SliderDemo() { return (
); } Installation Bash Package manager:npmpnpmyarnbun npx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/sliderpnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/slideryarn dlx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/sliderbunx --bun shadcn@latest add @sevenui/slider Usage TSX import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider"; ; Range Pass an array to defaultValue (or value) to render one thumb per value. Each thumb is indexed automatically in the order its value appears in the array. TSX import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider"; ; Examples Vertical PreviewCode TSX import { Slider } from "@/registry/base/ui/slider"; export default function SliderVertical() { return (
); } Multiple thumbs One thumb per array entry — three values give a three-thumb slider. PreviewCode TSX import { Slider } from "@/registry/base/ui/slider"; export default function SliderMultiple() { return (
); } Disabled PreviewCode TSX import { Slider } from "@/registry/base/ui/slider"; export default function SliderDisabled() { return (
); } API reference Slider Extends the Base UI Slider Root — all its props apply; the track, range indicator, and thumbs are built in. Pass value/defaultValue as an array: one thumb renders per entry, so [40] is a single-value slider and [20, 60] a range. With no value at all, a full-range two-thumb slider is rendered.
